basis: Build-input coverage, not a design rule: 2.0 m walking height plus 0.41 m route-floor elevation above the placed asset base; includes the 0.4 m lowered frangipani diagnostic. Native top is base + (2.0 + margin_m) / minimum scale. Upright props only. Plants use one positive uniform scale from villa_landscape._prop (authored height / native height); explicit intervals below cover current authored contexts and existing diagnostics. Smaller scales require regeneration, never silent extrapolation.
